eval_instructions: Each case is one user prompt sent to a headless agent with only the model-apps plugin loaded. `expect` is the model-apps skill the agent must invoke FIRST (genpage | app-builder | report-issue | telemetry), or null when it must invoke none of them. `accept` lists other outcomes that are also correct for a genuinely ambiguous prompt. `trap` names the mis-route the case exists to catch. Graded by run-routing.js over N trials against a pass-rate threshold.

Build me a model-driven app to manage equipment rentals: customers, rentals, and returns.
Build a Power Pages site where customers can submit warranty claims.
evals.trap: "build a site/page" wording bleeding into /genpage; Power Pages is a different product
